verdict.rationale: Fathom's api-reference markdown pages embed OpenAPI-style fragments such as `summary: List teams operationId: listTeams` and parameter `name`/`description` fields. This suggests per-endpoint machine-readable spec content exists in its docs. However, probes of every standard path (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404, so no consolidated downloadable spec was found. The llms.txt index is an adjacent doc map, not an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable full OpenAPI file at a known URL, explicit docs pointing to the spec, and hands-on confirmation that it is complete and valid.
